annotation.title_clean: Decision of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5 April 2011 on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund (application EGF/2010/013 PL/Podkarpackie — manufacture of machinery)
annotation.title_en: Decision of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5 April 2011 on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund (application EGF/2010/013 PL/Podkarpackie — manufacture of machinery)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 104/45
annotation.summary_en: 2011 EU Decision mobilising EUR 453,570 from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund to support workers made redundant in machinery manufacturing in Poland's Podkarpackie region. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mobilises EUR 453,570 from the EGF for the 2011 EU budget
Responds to Poland's application EGF/2010/013 on redundancies in machinery manufacturing in Podkarpackie
Based on Regulation (EC) No 1927/2006 and the 2006 Interinstitutional Agreement
